'''{{PAGENAME}}s''' are a consumable food item, harvested from apple trees, which are either found near the [[lighthouse]] or planted by the player in the [[orchard]]. These apples can be used directly to restore {{Energy||5}}, as an ingredient in a few [[cooking]] recipes, or studied.
